tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal sa skya pa'i bka' bsrung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len bklags pas grub pa bzhugs so// na maḥshrī ma hā kā la nā thā ya/ rje btsun sa skya pa yi bka' bsrung mchog /rdo rje gur dang gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa'i/ /gtor ma'i man ngag mdor bsdus rgyun khyer 'di/ /blo gsal don gnyer 'ga' yi don du bri/ /gtor ma lag len ltar bsham pa'i mdun du/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu sogs dgos pa'i yo byad 'dus byas la/ nang mchod chu chang gis gtor ma sbyangs/ yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed sngon du song nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ go ku da/ ha/ na las sha lnga/ bh+rūm̐/ āṃ/ dz+rīṃ/ khaṃ/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi lnga/ de dag gi steng du ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rigs lnga'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ steng gi nam mkhar nyi ma'i dbus su rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar zhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa steng du song bas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa la thim pas/ 'og tu lhung ste kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por 'gyur/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngon nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/

gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kar gyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gyi gaṇ+ḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang / lhab lhub kyi klubs pa/ mi'u thung gel ba'i 'dug stangs kyi ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭī sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ traka las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bh+yoḥlas dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung / gnyis pa na rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing / ba glang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can klu'i dbang po'i ska rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/

snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa/ lte ba'i thad kha nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'khro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa/ mgon po'i g.yas su pad+ma nyi ma ro'i steng du gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis/ rtsa ba'i zhal nag po ro za ba/ steng zhal dud kha mche bar rab tu gtsigs pa/ g.yas g.yon gnyis ljang nag zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gri gug g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas gnyis pa na ral gri 'phyar thabs/ g.yon gnyis pa na rus phreng / chang gis gang ba'i bum pa mchan khung du 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ sbrul dang rgyu ma rlon pa'i tshangs skud/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs/ zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang ba/ gdan ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ drag la rngam pa/ hā hā/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ gi sgra sgrogs pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon na gtum mo ljang khu/ mdun na sring mo dmar mo/ rgyab na siṅgha li ser nag thams cad gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las ya las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyi gri gug g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa/ maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/

byu ru'i lan tshar can/ yab las triḥtriḥyum las bh+yoḥspros pa las pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ triḥlas las kyi mgon po pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas lcags kyi ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar gyi aṅga rag dang / dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ triḥlas bha ṭa nag po slag klag can/ g.yas sher shing gi dam shing dang / g.yon mi'i snying rlon pa 'dzin pa/ bh+yoḥlas sring mo khrag mig ma kha nas me 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas spu gri/ g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin cing / za 'og na tri'i gos gyon pa lnga ka'ang sku mdog nag po rab tu khros pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal can/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren dge slong 'khar sil thogs pa brgya/ slad kyi rjes 'brang sngags nag ban phur thogs pa brgya/ mdun gyi shul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo spar ba gdengs pa brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag ce spyang / mi nag la sogs pa'i pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bh+yoḥyaṃḥmaṃḥtriḥtriḥbh+yoḥthugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka nas mgon po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum de bī ko ṭa sogs nas lha mo/ te se bsil ba'i tshal po ta la hā hā rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyan gyi pho brang gnas mchog kha'u'i brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas dpal gdong bzhi pa/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las kyi mgon po pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang /

/bdag cag rnams la phan btags phyir/ gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /lha mo kun gshegs gdan sogs yab dang 'gre/ /hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan mnga' ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs ltar/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las la spyan 'dren gyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /las mgon kun gshegs sogs lcam dral dang 'gre/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya ma hā kā li de byai/ ma hā kā la tsa turmu khā sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ gan+dhaṃ/ nai bi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de byai/ ma hā kā la tsa turmu khā sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi/ las mkhan pu tra ming sring bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bka' dang / dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs shig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung zhing rgyas par byed pa dang / bdag cag yon mchod rnams la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog pa dang / phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang / tshe dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par mdzod cig oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sar+b+ba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yaṃ di swā hā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na sa pa ri wā ri ṇi/ e ṣā pash+tsi mā kā lo3ya mi daṃ rat+na tra yā pa ka ri ṇaṃ/ ya di twaṃ pra ti dz+nya/ sma ra si ta dā i daṃ duṣ+ṭan+da/

kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā li de bi sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥ sogs gong dang 'dra/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta ḍoṃ bi ni tsaṇ+ḍa li rak+ṣa si siṅgha li de wi sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs 'gre/ oṃ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥshaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a shu ded/ mu rmugs spu gri a li ma dza dza nag mo sha la rubs dzaḥdzaḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi sarba sha trūn bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnams re re bzhin tshar gsum gsum brjod/ gong ltar mchod la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba to si/ ka ma la rak+kha si hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la rā tri ta ḍoṃ bi ni tsan+ḍa li rak+ṣa si siṅgha li de wi hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ṇi/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru ṭa bha ḍa/ ru lu rak+ṣa si/ sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba po/ /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ /kha dog nag cing ro la zhon/ /nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /bh+yoḥdapal ldan lha mo re ba ti/ /srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur zhing / /'dod khams mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mchog /dus mtshan nag mo khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur ba/ /nag po chen po mi zad gtsigs/ /mchu 'phyang shugs che byis pa'i gzugs/ /drag po'i sgra sgrogs khyod la bstod/ /nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa'i/ /bstan bsrung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes las/

/thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /'jig rten bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/ /mi mthun bar chad zhi ba dang / /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas te/ bsam pa'i don rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /ces bstod la phrin las gzhol/ /yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / mdun gyi lha rnams ras bris yod na de la bstim/ med na bdag la bsdu/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du 'grub nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngo/ hūm̐ 'jigs rung dus mtha'i sprin ltar nag pa'i sku/ /hūm̐ phaṭa nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i gsung / /spros pa nyer zhi mkha' dbyings chen po'i thugs/ /dpal ldan ma hā kā la'i bkra shis shog gang gi mthu yis brgya byin wa ltar zhum/ /ming tsam thos pas nad do cog las skyob/ /mtshan mo khams gsum myul ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /ma gcig srid gsum bdag mo'i bkra shis shog /dpa' brjid mi sdug mthing nag rngam pa'i zhal/ /ral pa dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ /ljags kyi dbang po glog stong 'khyugs pa can/ /zhing skyong gdong pa bzhi yi bkra shis shog /sprul pa bye bas sa gsum khyab par 'gengs/ /bdud dpung tshar gcod sgrub la dngos grub stsol/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa/ /pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis rgyas par bya'o/ /'jig rten srung ma bsten kyang gnas skabs su/ /'dod don chung ngu 'grub kyang mthar thug gi/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ /rgyal ba'i thugs nyid drag por sprul pa yi/ /bsrung ma'i mchog 'di mchod dang bsten byas na/ /gnas skabs lam gyi bar chad kun sel cing / /rnam mkhyen go 'phang bde blag stsol 'gyur phyir/ /yid ches dad dang 'dun pas bsgrub par rig

/de la'ang bka' srol mang yang sa skya pa'i/ /brgyud pa dri med las byung go bde'i ngag /rgyun gyi nyams len bklags pas grub pa 'di/ /sa skya'i dge slong ā nan+da yis sbyar/ /de lta'i dge ba kun+da ltar dkar bas/ /mkha' mnyam skye dgu kun gyi mi shes pa'i/ /mun pa bsal nas ye shes rta ljang gi/ /snang brnyan phrin las phyogs kun rgyas gyur cig/ //e waṃ// ༈ /dpal sa skya pa'i yi dam chos skyong rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i tho snar thang dpon mo la gnang ba// na maḥshri gu ru de ba bh+ya/ 'dir dpal sa skya pa'i yi dam chos srung rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ dpal kye rdo rje kho na dang 'brel ba'i tshe gzhung gzhan nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin byed la/ rdo rje phur pa dang 'brel bar byed na mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum gang rung rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa bzhin gyi bzlas pa yan grub pa'i rjes su gtor ma gzhan rnams kye rdor ltar byin gyis brlab la/ thog mar kye rdor la gzhung bzhin dbul/ de nas 'khor lo bde mchog la lū nag gang rung gi cho gas phul la/ rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi bskyed chog ni hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa mgon po'i thugs ka nas ya dang lha mo'i thugs kha nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las sogs gtor chog dgra las rnam rgyal las 'byung ba ltar byas nas/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kha'i dbus su hūm̐ bh+yoḥ aṃ maṃ tri tri bh+yoḥrnams las 'od 'phros ces sogs gzhung bzhin lcam dral la gtor ma phul rjes/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la phul la/ de nas dur khrod bdag po/ de rjes las mgon rnams la gtor ma phul la dkar bdud phur srung mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams 'bul zhing bshags pa bskang gso dgos na bya/ mi dgos na bstod pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la rdo rje'i glu bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa bsngo ba smon lam sogs bya'o/

/tshul 'di ni mdor bsdus pa tsam yin pas gzhan la gsang zhing thugs nyams su bzhes 'tshal/ rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil thang 'di'i khro bcu phra thabs sgo ma rnams 'di kha ltar la 'khor lo'i bar rnams la phyogs mdog gru chod kyi sras mchog rnams bris kyang rung zhing legs/ phyi rim khor yug gi lha dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams las bshad tshod ltar na/ phyogs bzhir dbang phyug ma bdun bdun/ mtshams bzhir bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ gru 'debs pa bzhi rnams slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa'i gtor chog nang bzhin bris pas rung lags/ dkyil 'khor mar bris na 'di bzhin mdzad dgos shing / zhing khams ma lta bu mdzad na/ dbang phyug ma dang phur bsrungs rnams ma bris pas khyab lags/ zhes pa 'di ni shrī bhū mi paṇ+ḍu ka mañdzu gho ṣā nan+da pu kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra ṇa li khi taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 sa lo chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ dpal sa skya pa'i bka' bsrung rnams kyi gtor chog rgyun gyi nyams len sogs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
